subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: Trophic level-4 is never found in the ecosystem.

solution:
The correct answer is__** Trophic level-1 has maximum energy.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The energy is maximum at the producers i.e Level 1.**
 
• The least energy is accessible at the most noteworthy trophic level while the greatest energy is at the most reduced leve
